title: Chaeremon
summary: Raleigh names Chaeremon in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Chaeremon, named with Manethon among those whose fabulous relations of Amenophis are found in Iosephus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVII, §. II, sig. 362b–363a
